dedupe_keys.name: acoustic data for the manuscript entitled self supervised acoustic leakage detection for water distribution systems a real time diagnosis framework under data scarcity

description: A Guangdong University of Technology team publishes labelled acoustic clips for water-distribution pipe-leak diagnosis. Zenodo provides three RAR archives under CC BY 4.0. The record identifies 500 one-second leak clips, 386 no-leak clips and 114 environmental-noise clips. Most samples came from an outdoor training base in Dongguan, China. File labels encode pipe material, region, pressure, flow rate and recording device, with missing values marked NA. These clips can train or benchmark leak-detection components in distribution-network monitoring simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this acoustic collection. Coverage is the recorded training setup and noise examples, not every buried pipe material or city background sound. A limitation is that laboratory-like training conditions may differ from field leaks and short clips do not model repair time or water loss. No archive was downloaded or classifier accuracy reproduced.
